messages:
ajohnson: FYI customer reported inflated charges when a streaming session was rehomed mid-request. Looks like some tokens were billed twice across routes.

maya: Can you summarize the sequence? was the client retrying or did router move the session?

ajohnson: Router moved it. Timeline: client opens stream -> router pins us-west -> model update kicks in -> capacity triggers rehome to eu-central -> client sends resume chunk -> server drops overlapping prefix and accepts remainder. Ledger rows show both sides billed.

leo: Classic overlap case. We currently bill generation time-by-route without a session-level dedupe key, so trimmed tokens that were generated on original route remain charged. When resume arrives on new route we charge resumed tokens again.

sasha: Are there tool calls inside the stream? mixing toolcall attribution makes the CSV export especially messy.

ajohnson: There was a toolcall (external search) between prefix and resumed suffix. Toolcall charged on origin route, so ledger looks like: prefix(us-west), toolcall(us-west), resumed-suffix(eu-central). Customer sees 3 rows and total > expected.

maya: For UX we should show a consolidated session view and let users inspect the raw ledger rows. They shouldn't have to guess which rows belong to same session.

leo: Technical options: A) Force all charges to initial route for duration of session (cheap UX), B) Always charge where work executed (accurate infra), C) Emit a session GUID so UI and exports can roll up. C seems least invasive and most flexible.

sasha: I vote GUID + tags. Also emit a `billing_flag` like `trimmed_overlap` or `resume_split` so analytics and support can filter easily.

ajohnson: Proposed internal meter API fields: `session_billing_guid` (string), `billing_flag` (list of strings), `last_confirmed_seq` (int as string in ledger for portability). Backwards compatible: keep per-row route and token_count.

leo: We'll need to bump billing export schema to v2 so downstream accounting can choose rollup. Also update reconciliation to prefer `session_billing_guid` when present.

maya: UX mock: show collapsed line "Streaming session <guid> — Net tokens 3,210 (split across routes)" with chevrons to expand raw rows + a "create dispute" prefilled with session trace and ledger rows. Add a tiny badge if toolcalls were involved.

billing-bot: provisional_invoice: session=ef56ab22 produced ledger lines: us-west 1750 tokens, eu-central 1600 tokens, toolcalls 120 tokens. total=3470 tokens.

ajohnson: Our net-delivered meter (post-trim) reports 3,210. Delta ~260 tokens appears to be trimmed-prefix duplication.

leo: Short-term action: start emitting `session_billing_guid` ASAP on every streaming ledger row. Medium: reconciliation job to auto-detect trimmed-overlap duplicates and flag them for human review. Long: router change to avoid migration during active streaming unless strict capacity emergency (sticky sessions).

sasha: For dedupe logic we can use `last_confirmed_seq` and a per-session `highest_billed_offset` in memory/store. If resume_offset <= highest_billed_offset, drop or mark resumed tokens as contrived. Edgecases: clients that send bad offsets or intentionally replay. Need trace tag `resume_offset_untrusted` when offset is outside tolerance.

maya: I'll prototype the UI with these fields. Want the GUID surfaced and a clear "split charge" explanation. Also add a link to raw router traces for the session.

leo: I'll open sync ticket PF-1043 to implement the meter API change and BLG-900 to update export docs. Also schedule a daily reconcile run to find likely duplicates and auto-annotate ledger rows with `reconcile_tag:possible_dupe`.

reconcile-bot: reconcile_scan: found 8 sessions in last 24h with route-split and token_delta > 50. Marked for manual review.

ajohnson: I'll draft an RFC for the `session_billing_guid` + `billing_flag` approach and include compatibility notes for billing exports and partner consumers.

sasha: Make sure to include schema migration plan and a feature flag for UI rollup. We need to avoid changing invoice CSV consumers without notice.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/session-billing-guid to staging at 15:40 UTC :rocket:.

maya: Ping me when staging has GUID fields so I can run the UI acceptance tests.

leo: Thanks everyone. Prioritizing the ledger tagging for this sprint per PM.

ajohnson: Thx. I'll add owners to the ticket and update the eng-platform board.
